scripts.build: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:css && vite build
scripts.check:rules: npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --project demo-mol --config firebase.json --only firestore "npm run test:rules"
scripts.audit:dev: npm audit --audit-level=moderate || echo Aviso: vulnerabilidades so em dependencias de build, nao bloqueiam.
scripts.security:semgrep: cross-env OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true SEMGREP_SEND_METRICS=off semgrep --metrics=off --config .semgrep.yml --exclude node_modules --exclude dist --exclude vendor --exclude css/tailwind.css --exclude package-lock.json .
scripts.security:check: npm run audit && npm run security:scan
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:html && npm run css:check && npm run typecheck:audit && npm run build
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run security:check && npm run test:e2e
